messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "doctor will decide what is right for you"
set: ["doctor will decide what is right for you", "ask your doctor what is reasonable for you", "you and your doctor should decide whether you will breastfeed", "doctor will decide on starting dose", "you and your doctor should decide whether you will take this medicine", "your doctor will watch you closely", "healthcare provider will show you what the indicator light and alarms mean", "this is not what most people pay", "call doctor right away if you have weakness", "what is the Zepbound Coupon or Savings Card", "What is the Mounjaro Coupon or Savings Card?", "doctor will determine right dose based on condition and response to treatment", "doctor will determine appropriate dose", "doctor will pick starting dose", "call your doctor right away if you have tenderness", "call your doctor right away if you experience agitation"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
JSON:

completion:
{
  "duplicates": [
    "ask your doctor what is reasonable for you",
    "you and your doctor should decide whether you will breastfeed",
    "doctor will decide on starting dose",
    "you and your doctor should decide whether you will take this medicine",
    "doctor will determine right dose based on condition and response to treatment",
    "doctor will determine appropriate dose",
    "doctor will pick starting dose"
  ],
  "alias": "doctor will decide what is right for you"
}
